name: Absolute Healthcare LLC
primary_service: General adult primary care clinic (Spring Hill/Tampa/Port Richey) offering physicals, chronic disease management, weight loss/body sculpting, immigration physicals and substance abuse treatment
notes: Services page lists "Primary Care, Immigration Physicals, Body Sculpting, Weight Loss Management, Annual Physicals, Vaccinations, Chronic Disease Management, Substance Abuse Treatment" with no autism, developmental, ABA or therapy service on either the homepage or the services page. The opaque name resolves to a general adult primary care practice, not a disability services provider.

name: BoardPrep Recovery
primary_service: Adult addiction and mental health treatment center (medical detox, PHP with housing, IOP, dual diagnosis, TMS) marketed to physicians and other high-stress professionals
notes: Site is built around a "Health Professional Program" of "Addiction Treatment" and "Mental Health Treatment" for adults, with no autism, developmental or ABA content and no adolescent or developmental program found. Confirmed as adult addiction treatment, an explicit exclusion.

name: Challenges Conquered Counseling Services
primary_service: General outpatient counseling / psychotherapy practice (Fort Lauderdale, Jacksonville, virtual statewide) covering anxiety, depression, trauma/EMDR, couples, teen, military, geriatric and pre-bariatric evaluation
notes: The site's own specialty menu — "Anxiety Therapy, Depression Therapy, Couples Therapy, Child and Behavioral Therapy, EMDR - Trauma Therapy... Teen and Adolescent Therapy" — never mentions autism, ABA or developmental evaluation at all, so there is not even a chrome-level autism claim to weigh. General counseling practice, an explicit exclusion.

name: Deeply Rooted Psychotherapy of West Palm Beach
primary_service: General psychotherapy group practice in Palm Beach County serving "children, teens and adults" — CBT, DBT, EMDR, ART, play therapy, somatic and telehealth for anxiety, trauma/PTSD, OCD, eating disorders, addiction and ADHD
notes: The site's specialty list runs "ADD/ADHD Counseling, Child Therapy, Play Therapy, Teen Therapy" plus adult trauma/OCD/addiction services and contains no mention of autism, ABA or developmental/diagnostic evaluation anywhere. Talk-therapy-only practice with no core autism service.

name: Dr. Pamela Silver - Psychologist
primary_service: Solo psychology practice (Silver Psychology Associates) serving "adolescents, adults, and couples" — individual psychotherapy, grief counseling, couples therapy, LGBTQIA+ therapy, telehealth, plus adult/adolescent personality testing
notes: The only assessment service is "Personality Testing", whose page says only "we use tests and other assessment tools to measure and understand your behavior in order to arrive at a diagnosis" and names no ADOS, developmental or psychoeducational instrument; autism appears nowhere on the homepage or that page. General psychotherapy practice with no autism-diagnostic or core autism service.

name: Elazar Bloom Counseling & Consulting, PLLC
primary_service: Solo counseling and consulting practice specializing in "marriage counseling and parenting consultations" for "individuals, couples and families", using EFT, ACT, DBT and EMDR
notes: Service menu is "Marriage Counseling, Parenting/Family Counseling, Individual Counseling, Premarital Counseling, EMDR" with no autism, special-needs, developmental or ABA mention anywhere on the site. Marriage-and-family counseling practice, an explicit exclusion.

name: Elite Pain and Spine Specialists
primary_service: Interventional pain management and spine practice — epidural and facet injections, nerve ablation, spinal cord stimulators, kyphoplasty, workers' comp and personal injury evaluations
notes: Services page is entirely interventional pain procedures — "Epidural steroids injections", "Nerve ablation/Facet injections", "Spine Related Pains/Sciatica", "Workers Compensation Evaluation & Treatment" — with no autism, developmental, pediatric or ABA mention on homepage or services page. Confirmed pain management, an explicit exclusion.

name: Family Solutions Center
primary_service: Combined neuropsychology, ABA and bilingual mental health practice — service lines are Individual Mental Health Therapy, Applied Behavioral Analysis, Family/Couples Therapy, Neuropsych Evaluations, Psycho-educational Evaluations, Immigration Psychological Evaluations and healthcare decision-making capacity assessment
notes: Qualifies on core service rather than a condition mention: "Applied Behavioral Analysis" is a distinct service line and the site's own page title is "Neuropsychology, Applied Behavior Analysis (ABA), & Mental Health Therapy | Family Solutions Center", so ABA is business identity, not autism listed among many conditions; a provider directory independently describes "BCBA-directed ABA with neuropsych evaluations" and "experience with Autism and ADHD". The word autism appears nowhere on their own site and the /applied-behavioral-analysis and /neuropsych-evaluations sub-pages both return 404, so whether their neuropsych/psycho-educational evaluations are autism-diagnostic versus ADHD/learning/immigration could not be established.

name: Florida Psychological Center PLLC
primary_service: Solo outpatient psychology practice (Glenn Sloman, PhD, BCBA-D) providing CBT/ACT psychotherapy and psychological/psychoeducational evaluation for a broad range of childhood and adult mental health concerns
notes: The therapy page's body list treats "Autism Spectrum Disorder" as the fourth of fifteen conditions alongside "Anger, Attention Deficit Hyperactivity Disorder... Depression/Mood Disorders... Non-Chemical Based Addictions" - autism among many conditions, not a stated focus (body content, not nav/footer chrome). The About page cites past New Jersey work with "individuals with Autism Spectrum Disorder (ASD)" and a BCBA-D credential, but the practice currently sells psychotherapy, not ABA or autism diagnostic evaluation.

name: Garellek Counseling
primary_service: General outpatient mental health counseling group - individual, family and couples therapy, play therapy, parent consulting and clinical assessment using CBT, ACT, DBT and trauma-informed care
notes: Two pages compared (homepage and Our Team) and the words autism, ASD, developmental disability and ABA appear on neither; specialties are stated as "CBT, ACT, DBT, trauma-informed care, couples work and play therapy" with per-therapist labels like "Trauma Specialist" and "Marriage and Family Therapist." This is a general counseling practice with no autism claim of any kind, so the stored "aba" tag is unsupported.

name: Glory to God Care, PPEC Fort Lauderdale
primary_service: Prescribed Pediatric Extended Care (medical daycare) providing licensed nursing care plus on-site speech, occupational and physical therapy and developmental programs for children with medical complexity; Fort Lauderdale center at 3625 W Broward Blvd
notes: The operator's own site says it serves "children with special medical and developmental needs" and "children who have medical complexities or developmental needs" and delivers "speech, occupational and physical therapy" on site, which meets the core-service test even though autism is never named anywhere on the site. Stored site glorytogodppec.com would not load (robots.txt connect timeout on both www and bare host across three attempts), so evidence comes from the same operator's gtgschool.com page, which confirms the Fort Lauderdale address.

name: Grand Health Institute
primary_service: Multi-location medical practice offering sleep medicine (adult and pediatric), neurology, family medicine, pediatric pulmonology and telehealth - a sleep/pulmonary clinic, not a developmental or therapy provider
notes: Scope of Services lists only "General & Family Medicine, Adult Sleep Disorder, Pediatric Sleep Disorder, Obstructive Sleep Apena, Neurology, Pediatric Pulmunology, Telehealth Services" - autism, developmental disability, ABA, speech, OT and PT appear on neither the homepage nor this page. It is an independent practice with no health-system parent, so no affiliate-credit question arises; the opaque "Health Institute" name conceals an ordinary sleep and pulmonology clinic.

name: Luminescence Counseling
primary_service: General outpatient counseling practice for adults, children, teens, families and couples using play, sandtray and art therapy plus parenting skills training
notes: Homepage describes only "Counseling for Adults, Children, Families, Individuals, and Couples" with "play therapy, sandtray therapy, and art therapy" and parenting skills groups; a second page (Location) confirms autism, ASD, developmental disability, ADOS and ABA appear nowhere on the site, including nav and footer. General mental health counseling with no autism claim at all, so the stored "aba" tag is unsupported.

name: Macy Grim Therapy
primary_service: Solo counseling practice (Macy Grim, LMHC) offering individual, teen, parenting, group, family, play and adventure therapy for children, adolescents and parents from a humanistic/child-centered orientation
notes: The homepage carries the full service menu - "individual therapy, teen therapy, parenting therapy, group therapy, family therapy, play therapy, adventure therapy" with a "holistic and nonjudgmental approach" - and autism, ASD, developmental disability, ADOS and ABA appear nowhere in it, so there is not even a chrome-level autism mention to weigh. The second page could not be loaded (repeated 429s on /services and /florida-clients across the fetch budget), but no autism claim exists to corroborate; this is a general child and family counseling practice.

name: Therapeutic Learning Center
primary_service: Public charter preschool program of The Arc of the St. Johns for preschool-age children qualifying for ESE services, providing specialized education plus physical, speech and occupational therapy and private ABA services
notes: Name/website mismatch resolved: Therapeutic Learning Center is a program OF The Arc of the St. Johns (arcsj.org), an "Empowering Individuals with Intellectual and Developmental Disabilities" nonprofit, not an unrelated business, and its own program page describes "a St. Johns County Public Charter Preschool Program" for "preschool age children who qualify for ESE (Exceptional Student Education) services" offering "neurodiverse-affirming behavior support," physical, speech and occupational therapy and "Private Applied Behavior Analysis (ABA) Services." Credit is given to this specific developmental preschool program rather than the parent organization, and it qualifies on its own; the word autism is not used, but I/DD and ESE eligibility are the stated population.
